text:
PQNK, Inc. is seeking a Intermediate designer /Job Captain with a minimum of 3 years of full-time office experience and at least a 4-year bachelor’s degree in Architecture. The ideal candidate is not only technically skilled but also compassionate, enthusiastic, and team-oriented, with strong interpersonal skills and integrity.
Since 2006, PQNK has been a full-service architectural firm where a collaborative team proactively creates meaningful architecture through a rigorous methodology. Our diverse portfolio includes multifamily housing, healthcare facilities, cultural venues, industrial projects, retail/food & beverage spaces, and public-sector projects.
Responsibilities
Assist with or lead coordination of all phases of a project, from schematic design through construction administration.
Develop design solutions, prepare detailed construction drawings, and ensure accuracy and consistency across project deliverables.
Oversee consultant coordination and manage responses to plan check comments.
Maintain drawing standards, digital file organization, and ensure CAD/Revit models meet firm protocols.
Communicate effectively with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal team members to resolve issues and maintain project schedules.
Review shop drawings, respond to RFIs, and support field coordination to ensure design intent is executed.
Research applicable building codes and ensure design compliance with accessibility, life safety, and zoning requirements.
Requirements
Minimum 3 years of full-time architectural office experience
Bachelor’s degree in Architecture (minimum 4 years)
Legal working status in the U.S.
Proficiency in CAD; Revit and 3D modeling software experience preferred.
Strong communication, collaboration, and organizational skills
Benefits
Competitive salary (commensurate with experience)
SIMPLE IRA retirement plan
Performance-based bonus
Paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays
To learn more about the company, visit our website at www.pqnk.com.
Why Join PQNK?
At PQNK, you will work directly with the principal and a small, collaborative team on a diverse range of projects. Team members gain hands-on experience across project phases, from design development and construction documentation to permitting and construction administration.
We welcome both candidates ready to grow into a Job Captain role and experienced Job Captains. Responsibilities will be tailored to your experience and demonstrated abilities, with opportunities to take greater ownership of projects as you grow.
How to Apply
Please submit your resume and portfolio to [email protected]. Include selected construction drawing samples and briefly describe your role and contributions to each project.
